basis: Optional proof work for the prepared SD2 consolidation package; explicit held outcomes remain valid without new reads.
attemptPolicy: One ordinary attempt; one retry only for temporary transport failure. No login/403/404 bypass or repeated probing.
oversizeOrIncomplete: Hold explicitly without truncation, source-silence or full-completeness claim.
selectionAndTriage: After direct selection, first reuse applicable saved proof. Skip a target if a complete held outcome is sufficient or no selected material accepted-use claim needs refresh; log the reason. No reread merely because this package exists. All locators require exact official-program/public/blank-content identity preflight; a candidate flag never proves that identity.
allowedFutureContent: Only exact unredacted original program/source URLs bound by locator references and hashes. Current official public named-program information or safe public blank documents needed for the same original inputs. No new host/award/source discovery or source winner by assertion.
nativeDocumentProposal: Only exact recorded Google document/file identity may use native connector id/name/MIME/view-link/size/modified-time/version/checksum and safe blank content. No folder/search/permissions/owner/comment/revision history. Stop on unexpected identity/type or applicant data. No current/public access claim from connected access alone.
documentHandling: Use complete appropriate text/page/table inspection where authorized and safe; exclusions/extraction/image gaps remain explicit. Temporary current blank-source material may be handled only in a safe task-local area; inspect/sanitize before persistence. No applicant responses, PII, credentials or uninspected raw files in Git.
unknownOrRedirect: No reconstruction of provider-redacted locators, name-only mapping, substituted award, new child adoption or inferred official relationship. Unexpected host/identity/access remains held; continue unaffected original inputs.
linkedPages: Only endpoints already present in the exact target list may be followed. All other child/pagination/document routes are retained as held outside-scope gaps; no silent loss or cap-as-completeness claim.
automaticInternalReview: One selected large run may use internal checkpoints, fresh-context independent reviews and author remediation without per-page/checkpoint human interaction. Preserve rejected and final bindings. A final exact-denominator audit is required.
underlyingTransportLimit: Budget bounds explicit source attempts/tool calls only. Provider-internal requests/redirect timing are not independently measured; do not claim an HTTP transport count. If required metadata/content/completeness needs more than2 explicit calls per attempt, hold rather than silently expand.
